A little studio, a lot of yarn.

Wooly Wonders is a one-person crochet studio. Every piece — from tiny booties to bento cakes — is made by hand, one stitch at a time. Because it's all made to order, each one carries its own little warmth.

Found something you love? Send a message and I'll make it for you.
